methodology.rule: Only information public at or before cutoff may be used for the simulated decision. Outcome is revealed only after decision is frozen.
methodology.purpose: Training examples for catalyst persistence, continuation, chase avoidance, and dilution filters. Not a claim of predictive accuracy.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Persist a high-quality primary catalyst for several sessions even if immediate price confirmation is weak; rescan for later validation plus volume.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Certification can be an underabsorbed catalyst; do not require a same-minute price spike.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Material upgrade/target change can produce multi-day continuation; retain on watchlist after day one.

cases.label: event_driven_late_risk
cases.lesson: A post-close M&A report may already reprice after-hours; alert quickly but distinguish discovery after publication from prediction before publication.

cases.label: gap_hold_only
cases.lesson: Strong earnings can be valid while a large premarket gap makes a fresh entry late; require gap-and-hold confirmation.

cases.label: developing_watch
cases.lesson: Do not expire analyst catalysts after one session; continuation and pullback/reclaim patterns matter.

cases.label: bearish_avoid
cases.lesson: New shares/pre-funded warrants/public offerings require dilution penalty and should not score as bullish merely because catalyst keywords are strong.

cases.label: late_chase_avoid
cases.lesson: After an extraordinary one-session repricing, default to late/chase risk unless a new independent catalyst appears.

cases.label: bearish_avoid
cases.lesson: Large offering plus warrants is a dilution/overhang pattern; high RVOL confirms repricing but does not make it bullish.

cases.label: bearish_avoid
cases.lesson: Unit offerings with warrants should receive strong negative direction classification.

cases.label: analyst_validation
cases.lesson: Upgrade plus a large target increase deserves positive analyst-action scoring; generic 'price target' noise penalty must not suppress it.

cases.label: late_binary_risk
cases.lesson: Constructive FDA briefing documents can reprice shares before the panel; after a large move classify as binary/late rather than early.

learned_rules: Persist high-quality catalysts for 3-5 trading sessions and rescore when price/volume confirmation arrives.
Penalize common-stock offerings, pre-funded warrants, ATM/S-3/424B5 overhang and convertibles unless context clearly offsets dilution.
Create a dedicated analyst-action family: upgrade/initiation plus unusually large target revision.
Treat large premarket gaps and extreme one-day moves as chase-risk states, not automatically high-conviction entries.
Use market reaction as confirmation, not as a requirement that deletes an otherwise valid underabsorbed catalyst.
